upstream_attribution.method: Exact shortest-path-tree warm refinement of published routes. Radix/A* trees with feasible per-sink bounds, neutral and group reroutes, preserved-route and displacement-chain repair, bounded excursions, and a multi-worker CPU search portfolio; the opt-in chain-fast modes specialize congestion pricing. This entry's own GPU kernels are audited prototypes and did not generate these routes.
